articles.title: Minister of Defence Antti Häkkänen: Finland to host NATO Deployable CIS Module
articles.summary: NATO has approved Finland's proposal to host a Deployable Communication and Information Systems (CIS) Module. Announced by the Finnish Ministry of Defence, this decision strengthens the alliance's operational capabilities and collective defence. It underscores Finland's increasing integration into NATO's infrastructure, demonstrating its commitment to contributing significantly to Euro-Atlantic security and enhancing interoperability among member states.

articles.title: NATO Operation Sea Guardian Focused Operation strengthens maritime security in the Eastern Mediterranean
articles.summary: NATO successfully conducted its first Operation Sea Guardian (OSG) Focused Operation of the year in the Eastern Mediterranean Sea on February 12, 2026. This significant exercise, led by NATO Allied Maritime Command, underscores the alliance's ongoing commitment to maritime security and stability in a crucial geopolitical region, vital for international defense cooperation.

articles.title: Aatmanirbhar Bharat: MoD inks Rs 2,312 crore contract with HAL for eight Dornier 228 Aircraft under Buy (Indian) category
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence (MoD) has signed a significant contract with Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) for the procurement of transport aircraft. This agreement, announced by PIB Delhi, strengthens India's indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities and modernizes its air force fleet. Such strategic collaborations are vital for enhancing national security, promoting 'Make in India' in defence, and achieving self-reliance in crucial aerospace technology.

articles.title: DAC clears Rs 3.60 lakh crore worth of capital acquisition proposals to enhance the combat readiness of defence forces
articles.summary: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), chaired by Raksha Mantri Shri Rajnath Singh, convened on February 12, 2026. Although specific details are truncated, the DAC's primary role is to review and accord approvals for critical defence acquisition proposals. This meeting likely resulted in significant approvals for new defence procurements, aimed at bolstering India's military capabilities and potentially promoting domestic defence manufacturing under the 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' initiative.

articles.title: INDIAN NAVY ASSUMES FIRST-EVER COMMAND OF COMBINED TASK FORCE (CTF) 154
articles.summary: India's Ministry of Defence announced a landmark development on February 12, 2026, underscoring the nation's robust commitment to collaborative maritime security. This initiative highlights India's strategic focus on strengthening partnerships and cooperation to ensure stability across key sea lanes. Such collaborative efforts are crucial for safeguarding India's strategic interests, enhancing regional security, and effectively addressing complex maritime challenges globally.

articles.title: Deputy Defence Minister of the Russian Federation Vasily Osmakov takes part in Coordination Meeting of heads of international military cooperation bodies of Defence Ministries (CIS member states)
articles.summary: Russia's Deputy Defence Minister Vasily Osmakov participated in a Coordination Meeting of heads from international Military Cooperation bodies on February 11, 2026. This high-level gathering likely focused on strengthening defence partnerships and strategic alignment among member nations. Such forums are crucial for discussing joint security initiatives, military exercises, and arms cooperation, offering vital insights into evolving global defence strategies for SSB aspirants.

articles.title: Stock Market Highlights: Sensex plunges 1048 pts to close at 82,626, Nifty 50 slumps 336 pts to 25,471
articles.summary: On February 13, 2026, Indian benchmark equity indices experienced a sharp downturn. The Sensex plummeted 1048 points to 82,626, and the Nifty sank 336 points. This significant market correction was primarily driven by intense selling pressure in metal and IT stocks, highlighting market volatility and investor concerns across key sectors.

articles.title: Denmark PM to hold Greenland talks with Rubio in Munich
articles.summary: Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen is slated to discuss Greenland with United States officials, including Secretary of State Marco Rubio, during the Munich Security Conference. This meeting underscores Greenland's growing strategic importance in global geopolitics, likely addressing security interests and resource considerations in the Arctic region, reflecting ongoing US engagement in the area and its implications for international relations.
